verdict.rationale: Finix is a payments platform that handles customer data, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no data-usage or AI-training policy and no opt-out control. The MCP server and llms.txt items cover AI access to documentation, not whether customer data is used for training, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
